title: Walkways.
officialText:
Walkways along belt conveyors or bucket conveyors shall be kept free of materials and, where 5 feet (127
mm) or more above the ground, shall be provided with a standard guardrail and standard toeboard that meets the requirements of
Section 3307.8 along the outside of the walkway. The standard guardrail and standard toeboard may be omitted on the side
toward the belt if the walkway is located adjacent to the conveyor.
